title: AI Recruiting Features & Dover MCP | Dover
excerpt: Dover AI for hiring: application scoring, interview notetaker, synopses, and Dover MCP for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Codex.
content_html:
AI & MCP

Hire faster with AI that lives in your recruiting stack

Score applicants, capture interview notes, and manage your hiring pipeline from Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools.

Works with

Works with

Bring Dover into the AI tools you already use

See how it works

Once Dover MCP is connected, your AI assistant can help manage hiring like a member of your team.

  • Which applicants for Senior Engineer scored above 80 this week?
  • Summarize the last interview with the top Product Manager candidate.
  • What’s blocking the frontend hiring pipeline right now?
  • List open roles that still need interviewers scheduled.

AI built into Dover

From first application to final interview, Dover’s AI workflows help your team move faster.

AI application review & scoring

Rank applicants against the criteria you set for each role, so strong fits rise to the top of the stack.

  • Score resumes against job-specific requirements
  • Surface top candidates as new applications arrive
  • Keep reviews consistent across your hiring team

AI interview notetaker

Capture interviews automatically with transcripts and structured notes so feedback isn’t lost after the call.

  • Transcribe video interviews
  • Pre-fill scorecards with structured observations
  • Spend less time on admin, more on judgment

Interview synopses

Get a clear post-call summary for hiring managers who weren’t in the room: signal without the full transcript dump.

  • Concise interview write-ups ready to share
  • Highlight strengths, concerns, and next steps
  • Keep decisions moving when calendars don’t align

Dover MCP

Bring Dover into Claude and ChatGPT

Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets your AI tools talk to Dover securely, so you can manage hiring from the AI tools you already use.

  • Ask about open jobs and pipeline status
  • Pull candidate context into your AI chat
  • Schedule interviews without switching tabs

Or set up Dover MCP in settings →

Generic MCP client setup

  1. Create a server named dover
  2. Set the transport to http
  3. Use the Dover MCP server URL

Dover MCP server URL: https://app.dover.com/mcp

Example configuration

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dover": {
      "url": "https://app.dover.com/mcp",
      "transport": "http"
    }
  }
}

Put AI to work on your next hire

Start free with Dover’s ATS, then connect Claude or ChatGPT when you’re ready to bring hiring into your AI tools.

Built for trust

OAuth scopes you choose

Connect with read access for jobs, applications, candidates, and interviews. Write actions like notes and stage changes only if you grant write access.

Same permissions as Dover

Agents only see jobs and candidates your Dover user can already access. Private jobs and role permissions still apply.

You stay in control

Disconnect anytime from Claude or ChatGPT. AI assists with ranking and summaries; hiring decisions stay with your team.

AI & MCP FAQ

Dover includes AI application review and scoring, an AI interview notetaker, and interview synopses, plus Dover MCP so you can use hiring context from Claude and ChatGPT.

AI & MCP

利用招聘堆栈中的人工智能更快地招聘

通过 Claude、ChatGPT 和其他 AI 工具对申请人进行评分、捕获面试笔记并管理您的招聘渠道。

与

与

将 Dover 引入您已使用的 AI 工具中

看看它是如何工作的

连接 Dover MCP 后，您的 AI 助手可以像团队成员一样帮助管理招聘。

  • 本周哪些高级工程师申请者得分高于80分？
  • 总结上次对顶级产品经理候选人的面试。
  • 目前是什么阻碍了前端招聘渠道？
  • 列出仍需要安排面试官的空缺职位。

多佛内置人工智能

从第一次申请到最终面试，Dover 的人工智能工作流程可帮助您的团队更快地行动。

AI应用审查和评分

根据您为每个职位设定的标准对申请人进行排名，以便最适合的人脱颖而出。

  • 根据工作特定要求对简历进行评分
  • 随着新申请的到来，筛选出最优秀的候选者
  • 让整个招聘团队的评论保持一致

AI面试记录员

使用笔录和结构化笔记自动捕获采访，这样在通话后反馈就不会丢失。

  • 转录视频采访
  • 预先填写带有结构化观察结果的记分卡
  • 少花时间在管理上，多花时间在判断上

采访概要

为不在现场的招聘经理提供清晰的电话后总结：无需完整的成绩单转储即可发出信号。

  • 简洁的采访文章可供分享
  • 强调优势、关注点和后续步骤
  • 当日历不一致时保持决策的进展

多佛MCP

将 Dover 引入 Claude 和 ChatGPT

模型上下文协议 (MCP) 可让您的 AI 工具与 Dover 安全地通信，以便您可以通过已使用的 AI 工具管理招聘。

  • 询问空缺职位和管道状态
  • 将候选人背景引入您的 AI 聊天中
  • 无需切换选项卡即可安排采访

或者在设置中设置 Dover MCP →

通用 MCP 客户端设置

  1. 创建名为dover的服务器
  2. 将传输设置为http
  3. 使用 Dover MCP 服务器 URL

Dover MCP 服务器 URL：https://app.dover.com/mcp

配置示例

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dover": {
      "url": "https://app.dover.com/mcp",
      "transport": "http"
    }
  }
}

让人工智能在你的下一次招聘中发挥作用

首先免费使用 Dover 的 ATS，然后在您准备好将招聘引入您的 AI 工具时连接 Claude 或 ChatGPT。

为信任而生

您选择的 OAuth 范围

连接职位、申请、候选人和面试的读取权限。 仅当您授予写入权限时才可写入注释和阶段更改等操作。

与多佛相同的权限

客服人员只能看到您的 Dover 用户已经可以访问的职位和候选人。 私人作业和角色权限仍然适用。

您一切尽在掌握

随时断开与 Claude 或 ChatGPT 的连接。 AI辅助排名、总结；招聘决定由您的团队决定。

AI 和 MCP 常见问题解答

Dover 包括 AI 申请审查和评分、AI 面试笔记和面试概要，以及 Dover MCP，以便您可以使用 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的招聘背景。
